decisions.requestBaseline: Use exact successful 1997 Metal Universe and Fleer HTTP headers: User-Agent Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; VCS Set Factory research import); Accept text/html,application/xhtml+xml; PageIndex pagination.
decisions.series: Combine 396-card Series One and 396-card Series Two into one equal-odds 792-card Base.
decisions.baseNumbering: Topps misnumbered two distinct subjects #370 (Benny Santiago and Mark McLemore) and skipped printed #379. Treat them as separate 792-card checklist entries, Mark uniquely identified in VCS as 370-M. Do not invent a #379 or split print-code variations.
decisions.gold: Gold parallels cover 792 cards, with checklist #395, #396, #791 and #792 replaced with four players. Must use source Gold checklist, never automatically clone base.
decisions.rookies: TCDB displays 118 rookie index source records; after duplicate print variations collapse, 116 distinct rookie card numbers are expected. Shared-subject cards need individual player-level RC verification; #158 Derek Jeter is not labeled RC (TCDB lists Mike Neal only). One source row omitted by HTML parser may be recovered only from the independently verified second-page number index.
decisions.packs: Four cards per virtual pack, 24 packs per virtual box, all base cards equally likely.
decisions.odds: Gold 1 per standard wax pack; Black Gold 1:72 standard packs; Finest pre-production 1:36 Series Two only => 1:72 across equal Series One + Two virtual pool.
decisions.excluded: 1994 Finest redemption cards, Black Gold Winners Redemptions, Certified Winners exchange and factory-only promotional sets, not normal pack-issued sports cards.
decisions.images: No fabricated artwork; scans, pricing, pack art pending.
decisions.release: Unreleased until complete QA on multi-player rookie labeling, image sourcing, pricing and pack probability review.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: 792 physical subjects; duplicate printed #370 includes Benny Santiago and Mark McLemore (VCS unique key 370-M); no printed #379.

productSets.name: Gold
productSets.notes: One Gold per wax pack. Four checklist replacements: #395 Bill Brennan, #396 Jeff Bronkey, #791 Mike Cook, #792 Dan Pasqua.

productSets.name: Black Gold
productSets.notes: 1:72 standard hobby/retail packs; 22 per physical series, merged.

productSets.name: 1994 Finest Pre-Production
productSets.notes: 1:36 physical Series 2 packs, adjusted to 1:72 blended across both equal-size virtual series.
